item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
• Volume limits: set the most each output can play at, and the volume keys stop there. App boosts stay within it too
  • Balance and mono for each app, including playing an app entirely in your left or right ear. Open an app's options (⋯) to find them
  • Protect from Sudden Loud Sounds: for the apps you choose, a notification after silence or a bang in a quiet scene eases in instead of hitting at full force
  • Smarter lowering of other apps during calls: pick any level from 10% to 80%, and they now fade back up gently afterwards. For voice chat like Discord, choose "while someone talks in it" in the app's options (⋯) so your game only dips while friends are actually talking. You can also stop an app's mic from lowering others, or keep an app from ever being lowered
  • Mute your microphone from anywhere with ⌃⌥⌘0, or with the button that appears while an app is using it. The menu bar icon turns red while you're muted
  • Full keyboard control: ⌃⌥⌘U opens Undertone from anywhere, then use the arrow keys to choose an app and set its volume, M to mute and Return for its options
  • The volume shortcuts (⌃⌥⌘↑ ↓ M) now change the app that's actually playing when the app in front isn't, and show which app they changed
  • Works well with VoiceOver: everything is labeled, and each app's actions are in the Actions rotor
  • A friendlier first launch: Undertone opens its menu to show you where it lives, explains its one permission (and the purple dot) in plain words, and offers to open at login
  • Apps you've turned down no longer blast at full volume for a moment when they start playing, open a helper process, or move to another output
  • Undertone lets your speakers or headphones sleep a couple of seconds after the sound stops, so AirPods can switch to your iPhone again and the purple recording indicator goes out
  • Less crackling on Bluetooth headphones
  • If macOS stops delivering an app's sound, Undertone notices and recovers by itself
  • A note in the menu when another volume app, like SoundSource, is also running, since two can get in each other's way
  • Saved settings are kept even if part of them can't be read

item.title: Version 0.1.2
item.description:
• New "About Undertone" in the settings menu, with links to Skirnir Studios and to report a problem
  • New "Send Feedback…" in the settings menu

item.title: Version 0.1.1
item.description:
• Set each app's volume from 0 to 200%, or mute it
  • Send any app to its own output, like music to the speakers and calls to AirPods
  • Other apps fade down automatically while you're on a call
  • Scroll over an app to adjust it, or use ⌃⌥⌘↑ / ⌃⌥⌘↓ / ⌃⌥⌘M for the app in front
  • Live level meters, smooth fades, and a soft limiter so boosted audio stays clean
  • Automatic updates
